A LITTLE CIRCLE TO MAKE YOUR OWN

Sea Turtle Mandala Coloring Page for Kids

A smiling sea turtle swims inside rings of curved waves and geometric shapes. Its shell has larger sections, with a few smaller spaces on the flippers for a little extra challenge.

  • Black & white line art
  • Large spaces for kids
  • Free personal & classroom use

Print your mandala

Print this mandala ↗

One drawing · A4 or Letter · Portrait
White margins and a smaller drawing help prevent cropped edges.

Inside this little mandala

The turtle is seen from above, with a large shell divided into polygon shapes. Its four flippers have smaller patterned sections. Repeating wave curves surround the turtle, and triangles and diamonds complete the outer edge.

A coloring idea to try

Choose two greens for alternating shell sections and two blues for the waves. Or create a fantasy turtle with a different color in each shell shape.

Make a little moment of it

Start with the shell and leave the smaller flipper spaces for last. A sharper coloring pencil can help there, while crayons work well in the broad surrounding shapes.

Use pencils or crayons for the smaller sections. Print on paper suited to your materials, and put a protective sheet underneath if using markers. Printing is free for home and classroom use; please link to this page when sharing the design online.
